provenance: User-supplied deposition and independent supplementary CIF; original download URL not recorded. Deposition identifier, source article association, formula, cell and structural fields agree in the source review.
transformation: Structure projection: source labels, fractional coordinate/ADP values and uncertainty strings, occupancy/disorder, symmetry operations, cell/temperature and H-refinement model are unchanged. Attribution, precomputed geometry tables, and embedded refinement/reflection payloads are excluded; full source attribution is retained in the source archive and private provenance.
input_validation: 27 unique asymmetric-unit labels, C12H11NO3, all occupancies 1, no declared split sites, four operations in P 1 21/c 1, Z=4. Supplied deposition and SI structural fields agree; projected file parses equivalently.
hydrogen_boundary: All 11 H positions are calculated/constrained; the original X-ray model is retained. Any normalization or later optimization must be explicit and traceable.
scientific_validation: Input checks only; no packing mechanism, surface fractions, energy ordering or universal scientific tolerance is certified.
stereochemistry_boundary: The source article names an E isomer, but the supplied deposition/SI geometry is Z at graph bond 7=8 under CIP assignment. This source-label conflict is retained explicitly. The physical object is the supplied crystal; do not alter its coordinates to enforce the article name. The mapped SMILES encodes the checked source configuration and contains no tetrahedral chirality assignment.
